subject: Claude Prompts The Biggest Debut Ever

Option traders expect 6% swing in the shares of Take-Two Interactive (TTWO).Elimination loss: Pennsylvania confirms eighth measles-linked death this year.

 Good morning! Here's the latest in trending: 

 No return: IEA chief says energy markets can manage without Strait of Hormuz . 

 GTA 6! Option traders expect  6% swing in the shares of Take-Two Interactive ( TTWO ).

 Elimination loss: Pennsylvania confirms eighth measles-linked death this year.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Top News
 
 
 
 Record books 
 
 
 
Getty Images
 
 
 History will be made today as the company behind Claude hits public markets. It was only five months ago that SpaceX ( SPCX ) became the largest IPO of all time, but it will now hand over the crown to Anthropic ( ANT ). The frontier lab has raised a total of $81.3B after upsizing its offering, resulting in a market valuation of $1.5T on a fully diluted basis (the total deal size is $107.3B including a $26B private placement).

 Snapshot: While the environment for AI stocks has been challenging in recent months, Anthropic is entering the fray amid a tumult for leadership. Nvidia ( NVDA ) is in crisis mode following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, and investors might be hungry for another AI player that can dominate the industry headlines. Shares are being priced at $83 , above its marketed $70 to $78 range, with the stock beginning to trade on the Nasdaq under the ticker " ANT ."

There will also be a spotlight on Anthropic's financials, as mentioned previously on Wall Street Breakfast. Revenue has jumped more than ten-fold in the first half of 2026 to $16.3B, but so have costs, with a net loss of $80.7B, largely driven by a non-cash valuation charge. While those numbers are staggering, Anthropic needs to spend big to compete in the AI arms race, as it faces off against well-capitalized firms like Google ( GOOGL ), Meta ( META ) and Microsoft ( MSFT ), as well as OpenAI ( OPENAI ), which is also in the battle to soon go public.

 SA commentary: "Anthropic's business is real: Claude Code changed how software is written, [but it] has signed $900.9B of compute commitments against $35.3B of trailing revenue, a fixed bill that does not shrink if sales disappoint," Rafa Oliver wrote in a new article discussing valuation . "A period of digestion across markets, businesses, and institutions is a reality check, not a risk ," noted Jennifer Warren, adding, "broad tech indices, select ETFs, and the S&P 500 will include Anthropic." ( 150 comments )
